(III) Its most striking finding is that close relationships matter more than money or fame. (IV) Participants who were most satisfied with their relationships at the age of 50 were the healthiest at 80. (V) Loneliness, by contrast, was associated with earlier decline in both physical and mental health.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça yakın ilişkilerin sağlığa etkisini anlatıyor; II. cümle Harvard'ın tarihine geçiyor ve III. cümledeki 'Its' bağını koparıyor.

(I) Many important medicines have been developed from plants found in tropical rainforests. (II) A drug used to treat childhood leukaemia, for example, comes from the Madagascar periwinkle. (III) Madagascar is the fourth-largest island in the world. (IV) Scientists believe that many more useful compounds remain undiscovered. (V) The destruction of rainforests may therefore mean the loss of potential cures before they are even found.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça yağmur ormanı bitkilerinden elde edilen ilaçları anlatıyor; III. cümle Madagaskar'ın büyüklüğüne geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Economists have long debated whether automation destroys jobs. (II) History shows that new technologies often eliminate certain jobs while creating others. (III) The introduction of cash machines, for example, did not reduce the number of bank employees, as banks opened more branches. (IV) Banks were first established in Renaissance Italy. (V) Nevertheless, workers whose jobs disappear may struggle to find new employment without retraining.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça otomasyonun istihdama etkisini anlatıyor; IV. cümle bankacılığın tarihine geçiyor.

soru:
(I) The white lines that aircraft leave across the sky are called contrails. (II) They form when water vapour in hot engine exhaust condenses and freezes in the cold upper atmosphere. (III) Under certain conditions, contrails can spread into thin clouds that trap heat. (IV) Some scientists estimate that this effect contributes as much to global warming as the carbon dioxide produced by aircraft. (V) Concorde was able to fly faster than the speed of sound.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça uçak izlerinin oluşumunu ve ısınmaya etkisini anlatıyor; V. cümle Concorde'un hızına geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Dogs have an extraordinary sense of smell, with up to 300 million scent receptors compared with about six million in humans. (II) Some breeds of dog were developed for herding sheep. (III) Researchers have trained dogs to detect diseases such as certain cancers and diabetes from samples of breath or urine. (IV) During the COVID-19 pandemic, dogs were also trained to identify infected people at airports. (V) Their accuracy in some studies has been remarkably high.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça köpeklerin koku alma yeteneğiyle hastalık tespitini anlatıyor; II. cümle çoban köpeklerine geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Snowflakes form when water vapour freezes onto tiny particles of dust in clouds. (II) Their six-sided shape reflects the way water molecules arrange themselves when they freeze. (III) Snow is popular with children because it can be used to build snowmen. (IV) The exact form of each snowflake depends on the temperature and humidity it experiences as it falls. (V) Because every snowflake follows a slightly different path, it is extremely unlikely that two will ever be exactly the same.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça kar tanelerinin oluşumunu anlatıyor; III. cümle çocukların kardan adam yapmasına geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Tens of millions of sharks are killed every year, many of them for their fins. (II) The fins are used to make shark fin soup, a traditional dish served at weddings and banquets in parts of Asia. (III) Because sharks grow slowly and produce few young, their populations cannot recover quickly from overfishing. (IV) Some sharks can detect a single drop of blood in a large volume of water. (V) Several countries and airlines have therefore banned the trade or transport of shark fins.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça yüzgeç için köpekbalığı avını anlatıyor; IV. cümle köpekbalıklarının koku duyusuna geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Millions of people in rural areas still lack access to fast internet. (II) This 'digital divide' makes it harder for them to work from home, study online or access public services. (III) Laying fibre-optic cables to remote villages is expensive, so private companies often have little incentive to do it. (IV) Some governments are therefore funding projects to bring broadband to rural communities. (V) The first transatlantic telephone cable was laid in 1956.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça kırsaldaki internet eksikliğini anlatıyor; V. cümle ilk transatlantik telefon kablosuna geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Energy drinks have become increasingly popular among teenagers. (II) Coffee was first drunk in Yemen in the fifteenth century. (III) A single can may contain as much caffeine as two cups of coffee, as well as large amounts of sugar. (IV) Doctors warn that excessive consumption can cause sleep problems, anxiety and heart palpitations. (V) Some countries have therefore banned the sale of energy drinks to people under 16.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça gençlerde enerji içeceği tüketimini anlatıyor; II. cümle kahvenin tarihine geçiyor.

soru:
(I) In a 'flipped classroom', students watch recorded lectures at home and use class time for discussion and problem-solving. (II) Supporters argue that this allows teachers to give more individual attention to students who are struggling. (III) Classrooms in the nineteenth century often had more than fifty pupils. (IV) It also allows students to watch difficult explanations as many times as they need. (V) However, the approach depends on students actually watching the videos before class, which does not always happen.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça ters yüz sınıf modelini anlatıyor; III. cümle 19. yüzyıl sınıflarına geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Flamingos are famous for their bright pink colour. (II) They are not born pink, however; their chicks are grey or white. (III) The colour comes from pigments in the algae and small shrimps they eat. (IV) Flamingos often stand on one leg, a behaviour scientists are still trying to explain. (V) In zoos, flamingos lose their colour unless their food contains added pigments.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça flamingoların rengini anlatıyor; IV. cümle tek ayak üstünde durmalarına geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Some smartphones can now act as earthquake detectors. (II) Their built-in sensors can detect the first, weaker waves of an earthquake before the more destructive shaking arrives. (III) When many phones in an area register this movement at once, a warning can be sent to people further away. (IV) Even a few seconds' warning can allow people to take cover or stop dangerous machinery. (V) Smartphone batteries tend to lose capacity after a few years of use.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça telefonların deprem uyarısı vermesini anlatıyor; V. cümle pil ömrüne geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Play is usually associated with children, but researchers argue that it is also important for adults. (II) Toy sales increase sharply before the new year holidays. (III) Playful activities such as games, sports and creative hobbies can reduce stress and improve mood. (IV) They may also encourage creativity and help people build social connections. (V) Some companies have even introduced play into the workplace to improve teamwork.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça yetişkinler için oyunun önemini anlatıyor; II. cümle oyuncak satışlarına geçiyor.

soru:
(I) A 'passive house' is a building designed to need very little energy for heating or cooling. (II) It achieves this through thick insulation, airtight construction and windows that capture heat from the sun. (III) The price of houses has risen sharply in many European cities. (IV) A ventilation system recovers heat from outgoing air and uses it to warm incoming fresh air. (V) As a result, such houses can use up to 90 percent less heating energy than conventional buildings.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça pasif evlerin enerji tasarrufunu anlatıyor; III. cümle konut fiyatlarına geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Many animals appear to have a basic sense of number. (II) Experiments show that monkeys, birds and even fish can distinguish between groups containing different numbers of objects. (III) Honeybees have been trained to understand the concept of zero, recognising that an empty space represents fewer items than one. (IV) Honey is one of the few foods that never goes bad. (V) Such findings suggest that the ability to count may have deep evolutionary roots.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça hayvanlarda sayı algısını anlatıyor; IV. cümle balın bozulmamasına geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Linguists estimate that nearly half of the world's approximately 7,000 languages are endangered. (II) When the last speakers of a language die, a unique way of understanding the world may be lost. (III) To prevent this, researchers record elderly speakers and create dictionaries and grammars. (IV) Some communities have also started classes to teach their traditional language to children. (V) English has more words than most other languages.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça tehlikedeki dilleri koruma çabalarını anlatıyor; V. cümle İngilizcenin kelime sayısına geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Some schools and libraries run programmes in which children read aloud to trained dogs. (II) Dogs were first domesticated from wolves. (III) Children who are nervous about reading in front of classmates often feel more relaxed with a dog, which does not judge their mistakes. (IV) Studies suggest that such programmes can improve children's reading fluency and confidence. (V) The dogs are carefully selected for their calm temperament.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça çocukların köpeklere kitap okuması programlarını anlatıyor; II. cümle köpeklerin evcilleşmesine geçiyor.

soru:
(I) The Sun occasionally releases huge bursts of charged particles known as solar storms. (II) When these reach the Earth, they can disrupt satellites, radio communications and power grids. (III) The Sun is about 4.6 billion years old. (IV) In 1989, a solar storm caused a blackout that left millions of people in Canada without electricity for hours. (V) Scientists therefore monitor the Sun closely to give early warning of dangerous storms.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça güneş fırtınalarının etkilerini anlatıyor; III. cümle Güneş'in yaşına geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Shrimp farming has expanded rapidly in South-East Asia and Latin America to meet growing global demand. (II) Large areas of coastal mangrove forests have been cleared to create shrimp ponds. (III) Losing mangroves leaves coastlines more vulnerable to storms and destroys breeding grounds for fish. (IV) Shrimp are rich in protein and low in fat. (V) Consumers can help by choosing shrimp certified as produced in environmentally responsible ways.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça karides çiftliklerinin çevreye zararını anlatıyor; IV. cümle karidesin besin değerine geçiyor.

soru:
(I) In the nineteenth century, the German psychologist Hermann Ebbinghaus studied how quickly people forget new information. (II) Testing himself with lists of nonsense syllables, he found that most forgetting happens within the first day. (III) He also discovered that reviewing material at increasing intervals greatly improves long-term memory. (IV) This principle, known as spaced repetition, is used by many modern language-learning apps. (V) German is the most widely spoken first language in the European Union.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça Ebbinghaus'un unutma üzerine çalışmalarını anlatıyor; V. cümle Almancanın yaygınlığına geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Hydroelectric dams generate about one-sixth of the world's electricity. (II) Many ancient civilisations built canals to transport goods. (III) They produce power without burning fossil fuels and can store water for periods of drought. (IV) However, large dams can flood vast areas, forcing people to leave their homes and destroying habitats. (V) They also block the migration of fish and trap sediment that would otherwise enrich farmland downstream.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça hidroelektrik barajların artı ve eksilerini anlatıyor; II. cümle antik kanallara geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Snake venom is deadly, yet it has also saved many lives. (II) Scientists have used compounds from venom to develop drugs for high blood pressure and heart disease. (III) Snakes shed their skin several times a year as they grow. (IV) One widely used blood pressure medicine, for example, was developed from the venom of a Brazilian viper. (V) Researchers continue to study venoms in search of new treatments for pain and cancer.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça yılan zehrinden ilaç geliştirilmesini anlatıyor; III. cümle yılanların deri değiştirmesine geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Graffiti has traditionally been regarded as vandalism. (II) In recent decades, however, some street artists have gained international recognition. (III) Works by the anonymous British artist Banksy have sold for millions of pounds at auction. (IV) Paint was originally made from natural minerals and plant materials. (V) Some cities now commission murals to brighten neighbourhoods and attract tourists.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça sokak sanatının kabul görmesini anlatıyor; IV. cümle boyanın hammaddesine geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Almost all international internet traffic travels through cables laid on the ocean floor. (II) These cables, often no thicker than a garden hose, stretch for hundreds of thousands of kilometres. (III) They are occasionally damaged by ships' anchors, fishing equipment or earthquakes. (IV) Because of their importance, governments increasingly regard them as critical infrastructure that must be protected. (V) The deepest point in the ocean, the Mariana Trench, is nearly eleven kilometres deep.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça denizaltı internet kablolarını anlatıyor; V. cümle Mariana Çukuru'nun derinliğine geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Many girls stop playing sport during their teenage years. (II) Football is the most popular sport in the world. (III) Surveys suggest that reasons include lack of confidence, concerns about body image and a feeling that sport is not for them. (IV) This is worrying because physical activity has important benefits for both physical and mental health. (V) Some programmes have succeeded in keeping girls active by focusing on enjoyment rather than competition.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça ergen kızların spordan uzaklaşmasını anlatıyor; II. cümle futbolun popülerliğine geçiyor.

soru:
(I) New metro lines often cause house prices in nearby neighbourhoods to rise. (II) Better transport links make it easier for residents to reach jobs, schools and shops. (III) The Paris metro is famous for its Art Nouveau entrances. (IV) As a result, homes near new stations become more attractive to buyers and renters. (V) While this benefits property owners, it can push out lower-income residents who can no longer afford the rent.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça metro hatlarının konut fiyatlarına etkisini anlatıyor; III. cümle Paris metrosunun girişlerine geçiyor.

soru:
(I) The meaning of eye contact varies considerably between cultures. (II) In many Western countries, looking someone in the eye is seen as a sign of honesty and confidence. (III) In parts of East Asia and Africa, however, prolonged eye contact with an older person may be considered disrespectful. (IV) The human eye can distinguish millions of different colours. (V) Misunderstandings about eye contact can therefore cause problems in international business and education.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça göz temasının kültürel anlamını anlatıyor; IV. cümle gözün renk algısına geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Many coastlines around the world are being worn away by the sea. (II) Rising sea levels and stronger storms are accelerating this erosion. (III) In some places, homes built on cliffs have fallen into the sea. (IV) Engineers can build sea walls, but these are expensive and may simply shift erosion further along the coast. (V) Many people enjoy spending their summer holidays at the seaside.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça kıyı erozyonunu anlatıyor; V. cümle deniz kenarında tatile geçiyor.

soru:
(I) In Japan, many people believe that blood type determines personality. (II) Blood transfusions were first performed successfully in the early twentieth century. (III) According to this belief, people with type A are careful and organised, while those with type B are creative and independent. (IV) The idea is so widespread that some employers have been accused of asking job applicants about their blood type. (V) Scientific studies, however, have found no meaningful link between blood type and personality.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça Japonya'daki kan grubu-kişilik inancını anlatıyor; II. cümle kan naklinin tarihine geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Ancient DNA has transformed our understanding of human history. (II) By extracting genetic material from bones thousands of years old, scientists can trace how populations moved and mixed. (III) DNA has a double-helix structure. (IV) Such studies have shown, for example, that modern Europeans descend from at least three ancient populations. (V) They have also revealed that our ancestors interbred with Neanderthals.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça antik DNA çalışmalarının bulgularını anlatıyor; III. cümle DNA'nın yapısına geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Research suggests that more unequal societies tend to have worse health outcomes. (II) Countries with large gaps between rich and poor often have higher rates of obesity, mental illness and violence. (III) Some researchers argue that inequality increases stress and weakens trust between people. (IV) The richest people in the world own several homes in different countries. (V) Others point out, however, that the link may be explained by other factors, such as poverty itself.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça eşitsizlik ile sağlık arasındaki ilişkiyi tartışıyor; IV. cümle zenginlerin evlerine geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Short-sightedness, or myopia, has become far more common among children in recent decades. (II) In some East Asian cities, more than 80 percent of young people are now affected. (III) Research suggests that spending more time outdoors in natural light can reduce the risk. (IV) Many schools in these regions have therefore increased the time pupils spend outside. (V) Glasses were first invented in Italy in the thirteenth century.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça çocuklarda miyopinin artışını ve önlemleri anlatıyor; V. cümle gözlüğün icadına geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Hummingbirds have the highest metabolism of any warm-blooded animal. (II) Hummingbirds are found only in the Americas. (III) Their hearts can beat more than 1,200 times a minute, and they must feed on nectar almost constantly. (IV) To survive cold nights, they enter a state called torpor, in which their body temperature and heart rate drop dramatically. (V) This allows them to save up to 95 percent of their energy until morning.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça sinek kuşlarının metabolizmasını anlatıyor; II. cümle yaşadıkları coğrafyaya geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Plain packaging laws require cigarettes to be sold in standard packs without logos or brand colours. (II) Australia became the first country to introduce such a law in 2012. (III) Tobacco was introduced to Europe by Spanish explorers in the sixteenth century. (IV) Studies found that the plain packs made smoking less appealing, especially to young people. (V) Since then, many other countries have adopted similar laws.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça düz sigara paketi yasalarını anlatıyor; III. cümle tütünün Avrupa'ya gelişine geçiyor.

soru:
(I) The first manned flight in history took place in a hot-air balloon in Paris in 1783. (II) The balloon was built by the Montgolfier brothers, who were paper manufacturers. (III) It carried two men over the city for about 25 minutes. (IV) Paris is known as the 'City of Light'. (V) The flight caused a sensation and inspired a wave of interest in ballooning across Europe.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça ilk insanlı balon uçuşunu anlatıyor; IV. cümle Paris'in lakabına geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Farmers around the Mediterranean are facing increasingly frequent droughts. (II) Many are switching to crops that need less water, such as certain varieties of olives and almonds. (III) Others are adopting drip irrigation, which delivers water directly to the roots of plants. (IV) Such measures can greatly reduce water use without lowering yields. (V) The Mediterranean diet is famous for its health benefits.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça çiftçilerin kuraklığa uyumunu anlatıyor; V. cümle Akdeniz diyetinin sağlığa faydasına geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Dance is increasingly used as a form of therapy for people with Parkinson's disease. (II) Ballet originated in the courts of Renaissance Italy. (III) The rhythm of music appears to help patients initiate movements that they otherwise find difficult. (IV) Studies suggest that regular dance classes can improve balance, walking and mood. (V) Many participants also value the social contact that the classes provide.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça Parkinson hastaları için dans terapisini anlatıyor; II. cümle balenin kökenine geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Several countries and companies are planning to mine resources on the Moon. (II) One valuable target is water ice, which could be turned into drinking water, oxygen and rocket fuel. (III) The Moon's gravity is about one-sixth of the Earth's. (IV) Another is helium-3, which some scientists believe could one day fuel nuclear fusion reactors. (V) However, international law on who can own resources in space remains unclear.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça Ay'daki kaynakların çıkarılmasını anlatıyor; III. cümle Ay'ın çekim kuvvetine geçiyor ve IV. cümledeki 'Another' bağını koparıyor.

soru:
(I) Bus rapid transit systems give buses their own dedicated lanes, separated from other traffic. (II) Passengers pay before boarding, and stations are designed so that people can get on and off quickly. (III) As a result, such systems can offer a service similar to a metro at a fraction of the cost. (IV) Many people prefer to travel by car because it is more comfortable. (V) Cities such as Bogotá and Istanbul have used bus rapid transit to move large numbers of people efficiently.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça hızlı otobüs sistemlerini anlatıyor; IV. cümle araba tercihine geçiyor.

soru:
(I) Maglev trains use powerful magnets to float above the track. (II) Because there is no contact between the train and the rails, friction is greatly reduced. (III) This allows maglev trains to reach speeds of more than 600 kilometres per hour. (IV) The technology is expensive, however, and only a few commercial lines exist. (V) The first public railway in the world opened in England in 1825.

Which sentence is irrelevant to the passage?
aciklama: Parça manyetik trenleri anlatıyor; V. cümle ilk demiryolunun tarihine geçiyor.
